newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee surges, cocoa treads water, sugar up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee surges, cocoa treads water, sugar up.

text.p: COFFEE - Bouyed by commission house buying but nearbys struggle to hold gains. Awaits green stocks. March up $13 at $1,323.
COCOA - Forwards post minor gains, nearbys in unchanged territory in lacklustre trade. March at 879 stg at 1519 GMT.
SUGAR - Nearby spreads narrow, March manages to hold above $300 support but premium reduces on strong raws. Up $1.80 at $300.90.
